$comment: ADDITIVE MINOR over management/v1.0.1 (T-270; v1.0.1 authored at T-194; v1.0.0 first published at T-188 / epic cli-mcp-mgmt-plane) — the management-plane route registry, cloud-owned SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (CON-4). 141 registry entries: 88 scope-gated implemented resource ops (the CON-4 headline; v1.2.0 (T-217) adds model_route.defaults — the recommended-defaults catalog read (routes:read, SR/free); T-199 D-GMT adds the 3 account-tier oauth.grant.* rows — list/get keyset-read + a direct_confirm revoke, additive within the tag pre-freeze) + 11 auth-annotated rows (A001-A009 + the 2 well-known ROOT canonicals A010-A011, scope none) + 3 deprecated_alias (A951-A953) + 39 reserved-501 (5 teams A108-A112 + 7 admin A801-A807 + 27 knowledge A901-A927). T-199 (F1, RFC 8414 §3 / RFC 9728): oauth.meta.as.root (A010) + oauth.meta.prm.root (A011) serve the SAME two well-known documents at the path-less-issuer ROOT (/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server, /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource) — the RFC-canonical discovery URLs the pathless issuer https://api.agkit.cloud derives — via the SAME handlers + middleware policy as the A007/A008 prefixed rows, which are RETAINED as working compatibility paths (both remain route_status:implemented; the frozen A007/A008 rows are byte-untouched, additive-only evolution). route_status is a CLOSED 3-value enum {implemented|reserved|deprecated_alias} (RN-5); auth rows are `implemented` carrying the boolean flag auth_annotated:true (NOT a status). The R4/CON-4 bidirectional drift-lock asserts these entries and the mounted Hono routes agree in both directions (A009 lives on the dashboard origin and is asserted via AS metadata, not the api router). Reserved rows return 501 not_implemented until their minor lands. Independently versioned from the streaming contract_version and media namespaces; immutable tag management/v1.2.0 (additive minor over management/v1.1.0 — the T-217 wave adds the model_route.defaults recommended-defaults catalog read, the R-B BYO-endpoint provider_credential members, and the R-C checkout email required→optional relaxation). Count-lock: 141 registry entries; 88 scope-gated resource ops.

path_abbreviations.note: All `path` values in this file are FULLY EXPANDED (no B/A/P abbreviations); this map documents the RN legend the human render used.

meta.auth_annotated: boolean column on every entry; true for the 9 discovery/self/oauth/well-known rows (A001-A009) which are route_status:implemented but carry no scope (scope "—"). RN-5 binds: there is NO 4th `auth` status.

danger_vocabulary.compound: atoms joined with `+` (e.g. "PR+D") for rows that are both prod-rebinding and destructive
danger_vocabulary.asymmetric: A506 kill_switch.set and A807 admin.kill_switch.set carry per-branch objects danger:{engage,disengage} / gating:{engage,disengage} (engage = emergency halt, disengage = re-expose)
danger_vocabulary.dynamic_sentinel: A704 plan.apply carries the literal "inherits_max_danger" (its max danger is computed at apply time from the plan's changes); it is EXCLUDED from the static CON-5 gating lock and confirm is enforced at the executor when the applied plan's max danger is in {D,PR}

meta.con5_gating_lock: Every row whose static danger contains PR or D carries gating plan_required or direct_confirm — NEVER direct/free. profile.sync (A416) is the SINGLE allow-listed PR-direct exception (OD-5).

drift_lock_notes.a009_via_as_metadata: A009 oauth.authorize is hosted on the dashboard origin (origin:"dashboard"), NOT the api Hono router; it is excluded from the bidirectional drift set (filter origin!=='dashboard') and asserted present via the AS-metadata authorization_endpoint (advertised at A007).
drift_lock_notes.reserved_return_501: route_status:reserved rows return 501 not_implemented at v1; generators (CLI --help / MCP tools/list) exclude route_status==='reserved' AND auth_annotated===true; deprecated_alias surfaces only under a deprecation notice.

meta.column_defaults_note: Reserved admin (A801-A807) and knowledge (A901-A927) rows render only op/method/path/danger/gating in APX-A §A.9/§A.10; the remaining columns are DERIVED per PLAN-ADDENDUM OVERRIDE 3 (admin: family '-', scope 'none (superadmin)'; knowledge: family 'knowledge', scope knowledge:read|write per verb; both default idempotency/concurrency/secret_bearing 'none', paginated false). Deprecated aliases carry a reduced shape (danger/gating/scope/family null = inherits canonical).
meta.pagination_metadata: T-198 (L1-G4, D-O4a / PL-17): the five keyset-paginated read rows (usage.requests, end_user.list, media_usage.requests, media_job.list, and T-199 D-GMT's oauth.grant.list) carry an ADDITIVE `pagination` object: {sort_key, tie_breaker (null when the sort key is unique per tenant — end_user.list's external_user_id_hash walk has no id tie-breaker), cursor_fields, default_limit 50, max_limit 200, filters ([] except media_job.list's ["status"] allow-list), required_index (the tenant+sort[+tie] btree the keyset walk rides), index_predicate (null except media_usage.requests' "capability IS NOT NULL" PARTIAL predicate — a plain (project_id, capability, started_at, id) index cannot serve ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC under a mere capability-IS-NOT-NULL filter)}. Boot-validated + frozen by the wire-contract paginatedRouteMetadata() accessor. PL-17 applicability: every route_status:implemented paginated:true row must carry this object XOR appear in the shrink-only PL17_PENDING legacy list (the seven pre-PL-17 .list planes — audit/project/publishable_key/management_token/attested_key/identity/plan — whose retrofit is an owner call at freeze, ISS). ISS-193 (PL-17 retrofit): DONE — all seven now carry a `pagination` object; migration 0044 lands the six new (tenant, created_at, id) backing indexes and plan.list reuses idx_management_plans_account_keyset, so PL17_PENDING is now empty and the live catalog assertion covers all twelve paginated planes. Legacy specifics: plan.list uses 20/100 (not 50/200) limits; audit.list carries the five-filter surface (since/until/project_id/action/actor); project.list (PARTIAL archived_at IS NULL), publishable_key.list and management_token.list (PARTIAL revoked_at IS NULL); identity.list is PLAIN despite its always-on capability=voice filter (an equality partial renders as capability = voice::text, which the assertion predicate-normalizer cannot match).
meta.killswitch_dual_mode_concurrency: T-198 (L1-G4, F1b): kill_switch.set concurrency moved if_match → if_none_match — the ratified DUAL-MODE vocabulary already used by identity.upsert + revenuecat.upsert. Required because the FIRST engage CREATES the project kill-switch row, and the hygiene layer's requiresIfMatch (router.ts) would otherwise reject an absent-row engage before the engine runs. PL-13's intent (If-Match when the row EXISTS) is preserved by dual-mode: absent → If-None-Match:* required; present → If-Match:<etag>. N-011's A506 ifm cell drifts under this move → recorded at close-out for the owner's T-202 freeze review.

routes.scope: union of WRITE scopes of all contained changes (eval at apply time)
